```yaml
name: Godot Addon Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        include:
          - os: macos-latest
            platform: osx
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux
          - os: windows-latest
            platform: windows

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive

    - name: Setup MSVC (Windows)
      if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
      uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@v1
      with:
        arch: x64

    - name: Setup Godot source
      run: |
        mkdir -p godot
        cd godot
        git init
        git remote add origin https://github.com/godotengine/godot.git
        git fetch --depth=1 origin 4.2
        git checkout FETCH_HEAD
        git submodule update --init --recursive

    - name: Build addon (Linux/macOS)
      if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'
      run: |
        cd godot
        scons platform=${{ matrix.platform }} tools=yes target=release
        cd ..
        mkdir -p build/${{ matrix.platform }}
        cp godot/bin/libamy.so build/${{ matrix.platform }}/libamy.so

    - name: Build addon (Windows)
      if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
      run: |
        cd godot
        scons platform=windows tools=yes target=release
        cd ..
        mkdir -p build/windows
        cp godot/bin/libamy.dll build/windows/libamy.dll

    - name: Create addon zip
      run: |
        mkdir -p addon
        cp -r src/* addon/
        cp -r build/* addon/
        zip -r amy-addon.zip addon/

    - name: Upload artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: amy-addon-${{ matrix.platform }}
        path: amy-addon.zip
```
